name: Deadpool (X-Force)

abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Shbleed Dooboof: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Daunted: Rakibin özel saldırılar sonrasında hasar almasını kolaylaştırır.
abilityDetails.Vicious: Hasar veren debuff'ların gücünü belirtilen miktarda artırır.

signatureAbility:
Superciliously Savage Slander
Each time the Opponent Purifies a Taunt Debuff or a Taunt Debuff on the Opponent is replaced due to hitting the max stack limit, Deadpool gains a Power Efficiency Buff reducing the cost of Special Attacks by 20% until the next Special Attack is used. Cooldown: [26 - 5] seconds. Max stacks: 2.
Against Skill Champions, each Shbleed Dooboof Passive up to 1 reduces their Regeneration Rate by [5 - 20]%.

abilitySections.title: Taunt - I'm the Merc' With the Mouth Baby!
content: Deadpool can inflict Taunt Debuffs on the opponent, reducing the opponent's Attack Rating by 25% for 16 seconds. Max Stacks: 3.
Inflict a Taunt Debuff each time the opponent fails to activate a Buff or Debuff during a basic attack. Cooldown: 4 seconds(s).
Inflict a Taunt Debuff by landing a Heavy Attack.

abilitySections.title: On Fourth Light Attack
content: Deadpool's Special Attack 3 is disabled for 0.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Bleed Debuffs - Duodenum Poke
content: All attacks inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [4,262.8] Direct Damage over 4 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.

Opponents that Purify, Cleanse, or use an LMD to remove these Bleed Debuffs are instead inflicted with a Shbleed Dooboof. They're basically the same, except they're Passive, deal 70% more damage, and have a different, dumber name. HEY!
If the Opponent is suffering from a Daunted effect, all Duodenum Bleeds instead inflict an Instant Shbleed Dooboof dealing a burst of [6,927.05] Direct Damage.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack - Super Slap
content: While walking forward, or landing Light Attacks 1 and 3, Deadpool builds up indefinite Slap Charges. Max stacks: 10.
While at max Slap Charges, slapping the Opponent with a Heavy Attack inflicts 10 stacks of Duodenum Poke Bleed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: During this attack Duodenum Poke does not have a Cooldown.
If at 10 Slap Charges, the final hit triggers Super Slap, inflicting an additional 20 Duodenum Bleeds, increased to 25 against Skill Champions.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This is Deadpool's Fav Attack and while fighting as a Defender he is 100% more likely to use it over other Special Attacks.
Each hit that is Blocked inflicts a Taunt Debuff.
If Deadpool successfully lands all his hits during the attack, he has a 100% chance to inflict a Stun Passive lasting 2 seconds.
The first hit inflicts a 50% Daunted Passive for 15 seconds, paused during Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a 60% Vicious Buff for 25 seconds. While this Vicious is active, all Taunt Debuffs on the Opponent are paused.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Superciliously Savage Slander
content: Each time the Opponent Purifies a Taunt Debuff or a Taunt Debuff on the Opponent is replaced due to hitting the max stack limit, Deadpool gains a Power Efficiency Buff reducing the cost of Special Attacks by 20% until the next Special Attack is used. Cooldown: [26 - 5] seconds. Max stacks: 2.
Against Skill Champions, each Shbleed Dooboof Passive up to 1 reduces their Regeneration Rate by [5 - 20]%.
